name: Frame Header Exposure Check
summary: Capture paired RGB and DEPTH streams and verify that UVC frame-header V2 exposes non-zero exposure time.

cases.name: Parse exposure from frame header V2
cases.description: Precondition: one RMSL module is connected in rgb+depth mode with auto exposure running. Capture RGB NV12 and DEPTH YUYV together; pass when each stream contains at least 30 consecutive valid V2 headers with non-zero exposure_us.
